program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (14.0, 10.0, 20.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),        # diff pair L (flicker noise / area)
    "Itail": (30e-6, 15e-6, 60e-6),  # tail current
    "I7":    (100e-6, 50e-6, 140e-6),# second stage current
    "gmidp": (13.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # PMOS mirror load and M7 gm/Id (shared -> no systematic offset)
    "Lp":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),        # PMOS L (M3,M4,M7)
    "gmidn": (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),      # NMOS current-source gm/Id
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),        # NMOS current-source L
    "Cc":    (1.0e-12, 0.5e-12, 2.0e-12),
    "rzk":   (1.0, 0.5, 3.0),        # Rz scale relative to cancellation value
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    CL = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    It, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]

    # differential pair (NMOS)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], It / 2, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    # PMOS mirror load and second-stage device: same gm/Id and L
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], It / 2, vds=0.6)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias: diode, tail, and output sink, all at the same gm/Id and L
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=0.7)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], It, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    # Rz places an LHP zero on p2 = gm7/CL
    Rz = p["rzk"] * (1.0 / m7.gm) * (1.0 + CL / Cc)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    # vinn on the diode side, vinp on the high-Z node x (correct polarity)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "x", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "x", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("Rz", "x", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1 = m1.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = m7.gm / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = m7.gm / (2 * PI * (CL + C1 * (1 + CL / Cc)))
    z = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Cc * max(Rz - 1.0 / m7.gm, 1e-3))
    p3 = 1.0 / (2 * PI * Rz * C1)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * 2 * m3.cgg)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p2)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / z)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / p3)) - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / pmir)) / 2
    power = vdd * (iref + It + I7)
    slew = min(It / Cc, I7 / (CL + Cc))
    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300
    vn_th = math.sqrt(16 * kT / (3 * gm1) * (1 + m3.gm / gm1))
    noise_1k = vn_th * 4.0          # rough allowance for flicker at 1 kHz
    cmrr_db = min(db(gm1 * m3.gm / (m5.gds * m3.gds + 1e-18)), 95)
    psrr_db = gain_db - 3
    swing = vdd - m7.vdsat - m8.vdsat - 0.05
    wu = 2 * PI * ugbw
    settle = 4.6 / (wu * math.cos(math.radians(max(90 - pm, 0)))) + 0.9 / max(slew, 1)

    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power,
               "slew": slew, "noise_1k": noise_1k, "cmrr_db": cmrr_db,
               "psrr_db": psrr_db, "swing": swing, "settle": settle}

events.topology: Two-stage Miller OTA (NMOS input pair, PMOS mirror load, PMOS CS output, Rz-Cc compensation)
